findings.title: Engine defaults hide omitted labels
findings.mechanism: Newton fills absent labels before finalization. Explicit and omitted names can become identical, so spelling cannot identify provenance.
findings.impact: A regex would change valid user identities.
findings.proposal: Carry known omission provenance and document unknown external builders.

findings.title: Pause can strand different final samples
findings.mechanism: A final periodic frame can remain in a replaceable slot when PAUSED is broadcast.
findings.impact: One browser displayed seq94 while the authoritative paused snapshot was seq95.
findings.proposal: Reliably flush the final sample before pause acknowledgement and state.

findings.title: HTTP offline simulation did not close WebSockets
findings.mechanism: Chromium kept an existing WebSocket receiving after the HTTP offline toggle.
findings.impact: The original fault probe could reject a healthy application.
findings.proposal: Use a controlled real upstream WebSocket close and retain the failed trace.

findings.title: USD axis flag adopts stage coordinates
findings.mechanism: In pinned Newton1.7, apply_up_axis_from_stage=True adopts Y-up instead of preserving a Z-up builder.
findings.impact: A Z-up Manifest could misdescribe imported Y-up transforms.
findings.proposal: Keep the builder Z-up and verify actual imported world pose and mesh bounds against independent golden values.

findings.title: Offline report browser inspection unavailable
findings.mechanism: The browser policy rejects file URLs. The requested local report file was not opened; no alternate browser route was attempted.
findings.impact: JSON and local evidence paths were checked, but offline filters/details have not been visually verified in this environment.
findings.proposal: Keep the directly openable artifact and its static verification separate from actual app HTTP/browser checks.

findings.title: Full scene rendering limits the unoptimized load path
findings.mechanism: Validated individual meshes submit102/502/2502/2002draws for100/500/mixed/2k cases under SwiftShader;10k cannot reach stable visible pause precondition within30s.
findings.impact: No valid10k FPS or acceleration ratio exists for this baseline. Initial small runs may overlap functional browser work.
findings.proposal: Measure instancing/LOD on equal fixtures/cameras/settings; repeat critical cases without competing browser load and report10k capability separately.

rules.title: Preserve the HTTP Pose read-only boundary during source pushdown
rules.quote: Pose comes from the latest published read-only snapshot; HTTP Pose requests must not trigger GPU synchronization.
rules.actual: The first source repair routed pose through a new full capture and asserted pose.seq greater than the prior full sample. Independent Spec review identified the conflict before final integration.
rules.mechanism: A stronger freshness oracle was applied to both explicit recovery capture and ordinary Pose lookup, bypassing the existing published-cache restriction. Kernel correctness evidence could not prove that HTTP ownership boundary.
rules.proposal: Keep explicit snapshot/subscription recovery capture; serve Pose from a single complete published cache with original metadata and test that source capture call counts do not change. Check the concrete public-entrypoint contract before strengthening an oracle.
